rationale: The description explicitly describes the product's data management capabilities as AI-powered.
ai_type_rationale: The description lists substantial conventional data-management functions alongside the AI-powered capability, which supports an AI-enabled reading, but it does not explicitly state that those functions remain without AI or that AI is an added layer; the subtype is therefore weak and forced.
evidence_spans: cloud-native and AI-powered data management capabilities
ai_type_evidence_spans: including data catalog, data integration, API and application integration, data preparation, data quality, and a data marketplace
conflict_response: Both proposals correctly retain a supported AI binary because the description itself says the data management capabilities are AI-powered. The concern is material for subtype only: classifying the AI as an added layer is an inference not expressly made by the source, even though the listed catalog, integration, preparation, quality, and marketplace functions support the best-supported AI-enabled reading. I therefore preserve AI-enabled with weak evidence and a forced subtype decision.
